crossRefs.note: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your…
Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled.
He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should…
Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his…
And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
Yahweh helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in…
He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

translations.web: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
